description: Place a real outbound phone call with an AI voice agent and get a call_id. The agent introduces itself as an AI assistant of the business you name, pursues the goal you describe, collects the requested data and hangs up. Destinations: Spain (+34), Mexico (+52), United States and Canada (+1), Colombia (+57), Peru (+51) and United Kingdom (+44). With a prepaid key, at their own price per minute (see get_pricing): Argentina, Belize, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Puerto Rico, Uruguay, Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands and Portugal. Calls are short (max 4 minutes). United States and Canada: informational calls only, every day 08:00-21:00 local time of the recipient, with prior_express_consent=true and call_type. Colombia, Peru and United Kingdom: service calls only, Monday to Saturday 09:00-21:00. Set call_purpose: service calls (appointments, reminders, surveys of your own customers, calls the person asked for) run Monday to Saturday 09:00-21:00 local time; commercial calls, only to Spain and Mexico, run Monday to Friday (Spain 09:00-21:00 and only from a 400 number; Mexico 09:00-19:00). In Spain and Mexico, no calls on Sundays or national holidays. You must confirm the recipient asked for or agreed to be contacted. The result is returned by get_call using the call_id. Pass website_url (the business website) and/or business_info so the agent can answer questions about prices, hours or services during the call.

business_info.description: Extra facts about the business the agent may need (prices, hours, services, policies). The agent answers only with this and the website, never invents

business_name.description: Name of the business on whose behalf the agent calls

call_purpose.description: service: appointments, reminders, surveys of your own customers, or a call the person asked for. commercial: selling or offering something to someone who did not ask for it. It sets the allowed calling hours; commercial calls to Spain require a 400 number

call_type.description: Required for +1 destinations: informational calls only, never cold prospecting

collect.description: Data points to collect, e.g. ['preferred date', 'email']

consent_confirmed.description: Must be true: the recipient requested or agreed to be contacted

consent_statement.description: How and when the recipient requested or agreed to be contacted

goal.description: What the call must achieve, in plain language

prior_express_consent.description: Required true for +1 destinations: the recipient gave prior consent to be called (TCPA)

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +34600111222 or +525512345678

website_url.description: Website of the business you call for. It is read before the call (up to 10 pages) so the agent can answer questions about prices, hours, services or address

name: make_call
title: Make a phone call
